title: Sam Darnold cements singular status among 2018 draft QBs as Super Bowl champ

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sam Darnold cements singular status among 2018 draft QBs as Super Bowl champ
sources.description: Darnold didn't deliver a signature performance in Seattle's Super Bowl 60 domination of the Patriots, but he eschewed turnovers to become a champion.
